question: Which one should get its own movie: 1, 2, 3 or 4? 🎬

first_comment: Tyapa's old cage was so low he couldn't stand up, and he drank from a hose. Now both bears' kidney tests are back to normal. What would you name a rescued bear? 🐻

stories.headline: 2 brown bears from tiny Russian cages now live in a forest
stories.summary: Bu was a circus bear and Tyapa lived in a cage too low to stand in. After 5 years of planning, rescuers flew them from Moscow via Abu Dhabi to Wild Ireland's forest sanctuary.
stories.why: War closed one route and airspace closures another, but more than 100 people refused to give up.

stories.stat_label: years old, and no tail feathers
stories.headline: A 121-million-year-old toothed bird flew with no tail fan
stories.summary: Two finely preserved Longipteryx fossils show fluffy bodies but only short tufts at the rear. None of the 19 known specimens has tail feathers, unlike any bird alive today.
stories.why: With a long toothed snout and odd shoulders, it likely flew in a way no living bird does.

stories.headline: Earthquake sensors finally showed how a hula hoop stays up
stories.summary: Berkeley engineers strapped building-test sensors to a hoop, leg and foot. Their data overturned 20 years of thinking: the hoop's spin and its wobble are driven together, thighs to feet.
stories.why: The same method could help design better rehab, prosthetics and robots.

stories.headline: A new Amazon reserve protects jaguars and river dolphins
stories.summary: Bolivia's new Agua Dulce reserve covers 715,000 acres along the Iténez River, home to jaguars, giant otters and 260 fish species. It links protected lands in Bolivia and Brazil.
stories.why: It helped backer Rainforest Trust pass 70 million acres protected, an area the size of Nevada.

fun_fact: The Iténez River runs about 780 miles, and most of it forms the border between Bolivia and Brazil.
